name: Gravecrawler
oracle_text:
This creature can't block.
You may cast this card from your graveyard as long as you control a Zombie.
blocked_sentences: You may cast this card from your graveyard as long as you control a Zombie.

needs.what: a card-level permission to cast this card from its owner's graveyard for its normal mana cost, offered only while a condition holds (here: `exists` a permanent with subtype Zombie that you control), with the card going wherever it normally would afterwards (not exiled) -- i.e. a `condition` on `graveyard_cost` (or a graveyard-zone self-permission static), the graveyard analogue of `alternative_cost`'s condition
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `graveyard_cost` is a strict CostModel with no `condition` field, so it would make the card castable from the graveyard unconditionally (a strictly better card). The `cast_from_graveyard` static does accept a condition, but `_active_player_statics` only walks the battlefield and command zone, so a static on the card while it sits in the graveyard is never read; and `active_zones: ["graveyard"]` has no reader for that effect. `grant_graveyard_cast` is a one-shot op with no source to fire it.
